annotations.title: Texas unequal appraisal: median of adjusted comparables

description: Evidence calculation only: not an appraisal or an opinion of value, not legal or tax advice, and not a substitute for the advice of an attorney. The arithmetic of Tex. Tax Code §41.43(b)(3) and §42.26(a)(3), the subject's value against the median appraised value of a reasonable number of comparable properties appropriately adjusted. Takes 3–200 comparables chosen by the caller, each with its roll value and the caller's adjustments (percent, USD amount, or $/SF, each with a reason); optionally normalizes each comparable to value per SF of improvement or land area times the subject's area; applies percentages summed or compounded, then amounts; and returns every comparable's normalized and adjusted value, the sorted list, the median (for an even count, the mean of the two middle values), and the subject's value minus the median in USD (subject_minus_median) and as a fraction of the median (subject_minus_median_pct: 0.1554 means 15.54%, a decimal like every rate in FactLot, not 0.1554%), with the statutes cited. Warns on mixed value bases, §42.26(d) and the §23.231 limitation, comparables in another county, fewer than 5 comparables, total adjustments over 25%, a comparable identical to the subject, no adjustments at all (the median is then unadjusted), and, with normalize_by none, a comparable whose area differs from the subject's by more than 25%. Each comparable row carries flags (code and sentence, facts about the inputs, never a reason the tool drops anything): value per SF more than twice or less than half the subject's, a land-to-improvement area ratio more than twice or less than half the subject's, an area the subject has but the comparable lacks. Optional label (up to 80 characters) and address (up to 120) on the subject and each comparable are echoed in the result (subject_label, subject_address, comparables[i].label and .address) for reports. registry_tx_equity_candidates returns calc_args, its candidates in this tool's input shape, for the caller to review and edit before calling this tool. It does not choose comparables, invent adjustments, or say whether to protest. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.tx_unequal_appraisal@1, every step, and any warnings.

adjustment_combine.description: "sum" adds a comparable's percentage adjustments and applies the total once (the usual adjustment grid); "compound" multiplies (1 + each percentage).

comparables.description: The comparable properties, 3 to 200, chosen by the caller. Values must be on the same basis as the subject's.

address.description: The property's address as the caller wants it printed (up to 120 characters). Echoed in the result; not used in the arithmetic.

adjustments.description: Adjustments to this comparable, each with a reason. Percentages are applied first (summed or compounded per adjustment_combine), then amounts and $/SF adjustments.

kind.description: "percent": a decimal share of the normalized value (0.05 for +5%, -0.02 for -2%); "amount": USD added to the value (negative to deduct); "psf": USD per SF of the normalizing area, multiplied by the subject's area (only with normalize_by other than "none").

label.description: What the adjustment is for, e.g. "age", "size", "condition".

reason.description: Why the adjustment is made, in the caller's words (e.g. "comp built 1998, subject 2006"). Required: FactLot never invents an adjustment.

value.description: The adjustment: a decimal between -1 and 1 for percent (0.05, not 5), else USD or USD/SF. Positive raises the comparable's value.

citation.description: Where the comparable's value comes from. Passed through to the output unchanged.

as_of.description: Date the value was read or certified, YYYY-MM-DD.

document_id.description: FactLot document ID of the source (e.g. the appraisal roll file).

fact_id.description: FactLot fact ID of the comparable's value, if it came from the registry.

locator.description: Where in the source the value is: row, account number, page.

county_fips.description: Texas county FIPS code, 3 digits, e.g. "201" for Harris. Optional; used only to warn when a comparable is in a different county (appraisal district) from the subject.

id.description: Identifier of the comparable, e.g. its FactLot parcel ID or account number. Must differ from the subject's and from every other comparable's.

improvement_area_sf.description: Improvement (building) area, SF. Required when normalize_by is improvement_area_sf. Must be greater than 0.

label.description: A name to print for this property in reports (up to 80 characters), e.g. its street address or the caller's comp number. Echoed in the result; not used in the arithmetic.

land_area_sf.description: Land area, SF. Required when normalize_by is land_area_sf. Must be greater than 0.

value.description: The comparable's value from the appraisal roll, USD. Must be greater than 0.

value_basis.description: Which roll value this is: "appraised" (after any limitation) or "market". Use the same basis for the subject and every comparable.

normalize_by.description: "none" compares whole values. "improvement_area_sf" or "land_area_sf" converts each comparable to value per SF of that area and multiplies by the subject's same area before adjusting; the subject and every comparable must then have that area.

subject.description: The property whose value is compared.

address.description: The property's address as the caller wants it printed (up to 120 characters). Echoed in the result; not used in the arithmetic.

circuit_breaker_23_231.description: Whether the subject is subject to the §23.231 limitation on appraised value (the circuit breaker for non-homestead property). Only used for warnings about which value §42.26(d) compares.

county_fips.description: Texas county FIPS code, 3 digits, e.g. "201" for Harris. Optional; used only to warn when a comparable is in a different county (appraisal district) from the subject.

id.description: Identifier of the subject property, e.g. its FactLot parcel ID.

improvement_area_sf.description: Improvement (building) area, SF. Required when normalize_by is improvement_area_sf. Must be greater than 0.

label.description: A name to print for this property in reports (up to 80 characters), e.g. its street address or the caller's comp number. Echoed in the result; not used in the arithmetic.

land_area_sf.description: Land area, SF. Required when normalize_by is land_area_sf. Must be greater than 0.

value.description: The subject's value from the appraisal roll (or the value at issue), USD. Must be greater than 0.

value_basis.description: Which roll value this is: "appraised" (after any limitation) or "market". Use the same basis for the subject and every comparable.

tax_year.description: Tax year of the values compared, e.g. 2027. Decides which text of §42.26(d) applies.
